Ran a deep structural study on Bitcoin across multiple market cycles from 2017 through the post ETF era. Anything beyond that is irrelevant and i'd argue you could even do this from 2019 onwards but I wanted to glean any insight during stark bull and bear regimes. 

Most standard setups rely heavily on RSI, which frequently lags or triggers false positives during structural chop. Don't get me wrong, I think it is a great tool and no shade thrown whatsoever. I just decided to  stress-test my custom framework built around liquidity weighted volume flows, rolling trend regimes, and structural exhaustion metrics.

Two major takeaways stood out across the data:
i) The 2022 Bear Market Desert: Notice how cleanly the model starves out false upthrusts while price was trapped underneath the 365-day rolling VWAP. It completely bypassed the noise of minor relief rallies, proving that exhaustion signatures mean something entirely different when macro momentum is inverted.

ii) The Post-2024 ETF Regime Shift: As liquidity plumbing changed with institutional inflows, the distribution flags started printing with heavy predictive weight right as structural exhaustion points converged. 

When you filter out the noise and anchor your execution to objective regime awareness, the charts look entirely different. Data over emotion.

#BTC

I see a lot of people refrencing our prior cycle bottom as it is the closest point of bias we can anchor to and it might make sense from a microstructure perspective to compare those markets (far more relevent than anything before that imo)

We bottomed around previous ATH from 2017 then engulfed the down candle that marked the FTX capitulation bottom 

But if we going to compare apples to apples, can see structurally nothing like what we have now. Also worth noting we have never consolidated and hugged a prior ATH like we did in 2024 for 200 plus days. Think of the psychology of the ETF cohort/others spent accumulating in and around that zone. Yes you can say these participants have a multiyear horizon or whatever, but reality is these buyers spent months underwater. Many are not entertaining further upside, if anything they are relieved to see breakeven prices at present. 80-83 k is very much staunch supply. 

That is the thing throwing me off a bit here. I will not discount a change in regime is in the making (momentum clearly has flipped locally). I just need a bit more information and one thing that will keep me sane through all this is my trend heuristic here. No changes on the weekly so will continue to monitor the flip if and when it comes. 82-83 k on a weekly basis will turn this boat around. 

Till then, im just going to keep taking set ups as I see fit. It really isn't that deep. There will be flushes and there will be upthrusts. That is all.

Easy to mistake local velocity for macro regime change.

Looking back at prior bear cycles, sharp >= 15% 3-day rallies beneath the 365-day VWAP are standard relief dynamics before structural bases form.

Time in correction (~286 days) and a downward-sloping 365 VWAP suggest caution until price proves acceptance above $82.8k
